guitar.evidence: Dan Donegan of Disturbed has had Ibanez and other signature-style guitars used in his career, documented in metal guitar press, though not as iconic as top genre icons.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with medium confidence.

tone.target: tight nu-metal palm-mute crunch with scooped mids
tone.profile: tight nu-metal palm-mute crunch with scooped mids
tone.summary: A highly aggressive signal chain using a powerful distortion pedal (RAT-style) into a Recti amp model with a 4x12 cab, optimized for percussive palm-muting and scooped mids.

rig.name: Disturbed - Down With The Sickness - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and excessive noise from high-gain distortion.
Provide a tight boost and slight grit to enhance the attack of palm-muted riffs.
blocks.gap: While Boost is ideal, OD 9 provides more aggressive saturation needed for nu-metal chugs. Using it as an overdrive/boost.

blocks.purpose: Add aggressive, tight distortion and saturation crucial for the nu-metal sound.
Model the required Mesa/recto style high-gain amp for modern metal tones and scooped mids.
Provide a solid, punchy cabinet sound suitable for aggressive rock genres.
blocks.gap: While the Recti amp is modeled after Mesa/Boogie, using UK Vintage 4x12 provides a reliable and powerful sounding cab option available in the catalog.

blocks.purpose: Aggressively scoop the mids and boost low-end punch for maximum chug.
No wah needed for this aggressive, percussive tone.
Disabled to avoid washiness and maintain tightness.
Add minimal, controlled ambience without sounding washy.
blocks.gap: The verdict specified avoiding 'washy reverb,' so settings are kept low and the module is placed late in the chain for subtle depth.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to better match the aggressive, modern metal tone and enhance low-end punch.

proposals.reason: The current cab is generic; a specialized metal IR will improve tightness and low-end punch.
